title: Synthesis: Managing Belongings on a Journey

sections.content:
When preparing for a journey, plural possessed nouns frequently take the accusative case (-at/-et/-ot/t):
- *a kulcsaim* → **a kulcsaimat** (my keys - acc.)
- *a dolgaim* → **a dolgaimat** (my things - acc.)
- *az irataim* → **az irataimat** (my documents - acc.)
- *a jegyeid* → **a jegyeidet** (your tickets - acc.)
- *a ruháink* → **a ruháinkat** (our clothes - acc.)

items.spanish: Nem felejtem el a jegyeimet és az irataimat az asztalon.
items.english: I don't forget my tickets and my documents on the table.

items.spanish: Gyorsan összepakoljuk a holmijainkat a nagy bőröndbe.
items.english: We quickly pack our belongings into the big suitcase.

items.spanish: Hol vannak a lakáskulcsaid? Betetted őket a táskádba?
items.english: Where are your apartment keys? Did you put them into your bag?
